posts.text:
Rising bond yields aren't a crisis. Nothing here looks disorderly, nothing says big trouble is coming tomorrow.⁣
⁣
But it will still touch your life. That can look like higher rates on mortgages, car loans, student loans.⁣
⁣
Not good, but not catastrophic

posts.text: US dollar dominance isn't magic. Everyone prices things in dollars. So everyone contracts in dollars. So everyone ends up trading through dollars. The US is at the center because everyone else agreed to use our $$. https://newsletter.platypuseconomics.com/p/the-dollar-is-just-a-social-convention
